task_instance: Build a month-end close calendar and status-tracking dashboard for a sample company (Acme Widgets Inc., September 2026 close) using the skill's checklist, task dependency map, and status dashboard template: sequence all pre-close through T+5 tasks by dependency level, assign owners/deadlines from sample contributor data, flag realistic blockers/at-risk items from sample known-items data, and include a close metrics baseline table.
evidence: Created company_close_inputs.md (sample company data: contributors, known close items like pending intercompany confirmations, FX exposure, a pending revenue-recognition contract) and close_calendar_and_status.md (the actual deliverable) in the work directory. The calendar sequences every checklist item from SKILL.md's Pre-Close through T+5 sections, ordered per the skill's dependency map (Level 1 no-dependency tasks on T+1, Level 2 depends-on-T+1 tasks on T+2, etc.), each with an owner, deadline, and status per the skill's Status Tracking dashboard schema (Not Started/In Progress/Complete/Blocked/At Risk). Two tasks were marked Blocked/At Risk reflecting the sample company's known open items (EU intercompany confirmation, pending revenue recognition contract review), each with a blocker/impact/escalation row in a dedicated blockers table. A close metrics baseline table (duration, adjusting entries, late tasks, reconciliation exceptions, restatements) was also included per the skill's metrics section. Verified with `wc -l` (84 lines) and `grep -c` showing 60 markdown table rows and 37 status-field occurrences across the calendar, blockers, and metrics sections -- confirming the full checklist and dependency structure was represented, not just a stub. This is a pure text/document-generation deliverable requiring only file read/write; no scripts, external tools, network access, or credentials were needed or missing.
